title: Frigidaire — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Frigidaire.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Designed to Fit Your Life." Frigidaire has been a kitchen staple since 1918. As the value tier of the Electrolux portfolio, Frigidaire delivers surprisingly strong features at accessible prices. Air Fry is now standard across the range lineup, EvenTemp cooling eliminates hot and cold spots in refrigerators, and the Gallery line offers near-premium performance at mid-range prices.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Budget-conscious buyers who still want modern features. First-time homeowners. Anyone who wants Air Fry without paying premium prices.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Frigidaire:

• Air Fry built into the range — no countertop gadget needed, works in your oven

• EvenTemp cooling system eliminates hot and cold spots throughout the fridge

• Gallery line gives you 80% of premium features at 60% of the price

• SpaceWise organization system maximizes every inch of freezer space

• PureSource Ultra water filtration — cleaner water and ice than most premium brands
